scope: Linux fresh source, local unreleased sdist/wheel and actual offline Calc/browser verification. No registry release, tag, manual deployment or remote CI result claimed.

package.status: local unreleased wheel built from sdist

checks.skipScope: Five optional native Tesseract tests; the system binary is unavailable. Mocked OCR and all numeric-export cases run.

nativeSpreadsheet.scope: Actual offline Calc reads. Boolean cells are internally represented as TRUE()/FALSE() formulas by Calc; source workbooks contain typed boolean cells and no formulas. Baseline writer exception is captured separately.

harnessNotes: A burst of export clicks timed out waiting for a download; final replay uses separate user-paced downloads. No application change was made for that observation.
The native-server evidence driver initially passed an unopened WriteStream as child stdio. It now pipes child output, and the complete final replay was rerun.
The full final package uses scripts/bundle_ui.py and a wheel built from that sdist. Both final installs and their native bundled UI were verified separately from preliminary unbundled packages.
limits: Text fallback preserves current scalar spellings, not prior float/JSON precision loss.
Converted cells require explicit conversion for spreadsheet arithmetic.
The direct writer accepts the 401-digit integer; the existing API correction bounds still reject it with 422.
Microsoft Excel interactive behavior was not tested.
